section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section affirms that the present study found gratitude to be significantly related to self-reported physical health, specifically perceived somatic symptoms, in an adult sample. It provides novel evidence that gratitude improves physical health by reducing subjective experiences of loneliness, serving as a mediator. The section also discusses theoretical accounts for this mechanism, acknowledges limitations such as sample characteristics and the cross-sectional design, and suggests future research directions including experimental and longitudinal designs with objective health markers.
